findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials in source code and Terraform state. Anyone with access to the code repository, Terraform state file, or AWS console/API access to the Lambda function can read these credentials.

The Lambda function does not specify a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables, relying only on default AWS-managed encryption, which is weaker protection for the sensitive secrets stored in the environment block.
